name: Kiln · iOS

prepare.name: export
command: export LOGNAME="$(id -un)"; bun ../engine/cli/kiln.ts export ios --out generated/ios --signing external

tests.name: ios-artifact
command: import zipfile,plistlib,os,glob; files=glob.glob('*.ipa'); assert len(files)==1; z=zipfile.ZipFile(files[0]); p=next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('Payload/') and n.count('/')==2 and n.endswith('/Info.plist')); info=plistlib.loads(z.read(p)); root=p[:-len('Info.plist')]; assert root+'Kiln/game.js' in z.namelist(); assert info['CFBundleIdentifier']=='{{bundle_id}}'; assert info['CFBundleShortVersionString']; assert int(info['CFBundleVersion'])>0; assert any(n.startswith(root+'_CodeSignature/') for n in z.namelist()); assert root+'embedded.mobileprovision' in z.namelist()

description: Export a self-contained Xcode project, then let Deploy archive, sign and export an IPA. Requires a pinned engine sibling.
